```{r message=FALSE}
here::i_am("extensions/balanced.Rmd")

reg_final_path <- here::here("replication", "output", "regression_data_final.rds")
reg_final <- readRDS(reg_final_path)

models_path <- here::here("replication", "output", "models_tech_pharma.rds")
models_tech_pharma <- readRDS(models_path)
```

```{r}
# Identify firms observed in all eight years
firm_years <- table(reg_final$gvkey)

balanced_ids <- names(
  firm_years[firm_years == 8]
)

# Keep balanced panel
balanced_data <- subset(
  reg_final,
  gvkey %in% balanced_ids
)

# Estimate regression
models_balanced_tech_pharma <- list()
models_balanced_tech_pharma$fa <- fixest::feols(
  fa_ratio ~ post:tech_dummy + post:pharma_dummy |
    gvkey + year,
  data = balanced_data,
  vcov = ~gvkey
)
models_balanced_tech_pharma$cash <- fixest::feols(
  cash_ratio ~ post:tech_dummy + post:pharma_dummy |
    gvkey + year,
  data = balanced_data,
  vcov = ~gvkey
)
models_balanced_tech_pharma$mkt <- fixest::feols(
  mkt_ratio ~ post:tech_dummy + post:pharma_dummy |
    gvkey + year,
  data = balanced_data,
  vcov = ~gvkey
)

# Compare models using clustered standard errors
models_compared <- c(models_tech_pharma, models_balanced_tech_pharma)[c(1, 4, 2, 5, 3, 6)]
names(models_compared) <- rep(c("imbalanced", "balanced"), 3)
fixest::etable(models_compared, vcov = ~gvkey)
```
